jobs.title: AI Solution Expert
jobs.description: AI Solution Expert Careers > Position AI Solution Expert Customer Success Holon, Israel, Holon Description DealHub.AI is building the future of agentic revenue technology. Trusted by leading global businesses, we’re redefining what revenue teams can achieve with AI and agentic execution across the deal lifecycle. Our mission is simple: help businesses Own Your Revenue with greater speed, intelligence, and governance. As an AI Solution Expert , you will serve as the technical trusted advisor for our customers, bridging AI capabilities with their specific business goals and revenue workflows. You will embed deeply with customers. Part consultant, part engineer, part strategic advisor: leading AI sessions, configuring AI-driven workflows using DealHub MCP, training users on best practices, and ensuring measurable business outcomes. You'll collaborate closely with Customer Success, Product, Support, and Engineering teams, and will be the go-to expert for any AI-related technical solution. This is an ideal role for someone who thrives at the intersection of cutting-edge AI technology and real-world business challenges. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on ambiguity, moves fast, and finds equal satisfaction in writing clean code and presenting a solution to a CFO. Key Responsibilities Embed deeply with customers to understand their technical environment, business processes, and AI workflows and then design and build solutions that fit. Build and deploy AI-powered workflows, MCP-based automations, and intelligent features within the DealHub platform tailored to each customer's use case taking into account the integration landscape such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics, NetSuite, and billing platforms. Leverage LLM, AI, APIs, webhooks, data pipelines, automation scripts. Lead technical AI sessions — review requirements, demo solutions, help build agents and perform training. Translate complex AI and technical concepts into clear, tangible business value; operate as a trusted advisor, not just an implementer. Identify and resolve technical blockers proactively; operate with confidence under ambiguity and incomplete information. Build reusable engineering assets: integration libraries, prompt templates, and AI workflow scaffolding that scale across the customer base. Act as a direct feedback loop from the field to the Product and Engineering teams surfacing patterns, edge cases, and AI feature opportunities discovered during deployments. Monitor post-go-live and drive continuous improvement. Requirements 3–4+ years of hands-on experience in implementation roles , such as Solution Expert or Implementation Manager, with at least 1 year of hands-on experience implementing and building MCP-based agents and skills . Strong understanding of MCP architecture and implementation. Hands-on experience building AI agents and skills using tools such as Claude and Copilot . Experience with low-code/no-code automation platforms such as Zapier, Make, and n8n , as well as the ability to develop custom code-based solutions. Prior experience in a technical, customer-facing role in SaaS (e.g., forward deployment, solutions engineering, implementation, or technical consulting) Proven, in-depth knowledge of CRM systems (Salesforce / HubSpot / Dynamics), ERP and Billing tools Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills; comfortable reasoning about data models, integration architecture, and failure modes. Excellent communication skills in English — able to present a technical architecture to an engineer and a business case to a VP on the same day. Able to juggle multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously without dropping the ball. Fluent in English (written and verbal). Degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Information Technology, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent). Apply to this job Back to careers page

jobs.title: Senior Customer Support Specialist
jobs.description: Senior Customer Support Specialist Careers > Position Senior Customer Support Specialist Customer Success Manila, Philippines, Manila Description DealHub.AI is building the future of agentic revenue technology. Trusted by leading global businesses, we’re redefining what revenue teams can achieve with AI and agentic execution across the deal lifecycle. Our mission is simple: help businesses Own Your Revenue with greater speed, intelligence, and governance. With an amazing customer-oriented approach and sharp minds, the Support team helps our customers solve technical problems and find the right solutions for their business needs. We're seeking a Senior Customer Support Specialist — a deep technical expert on the DealHub platform who can independently untangle the hardest, most ambiguous customer issues, including complex CRM integration and configuration edge cases that go beyond standard troubleshooting playbooks. Key Responsibilities Own and resolve the most complex, technically ambiguous, and escalated support cases for DealHub's customers worldwide. Provide expert-level application support on DealHub's platform, with deep knowledge of configuration logic, workflow engines, and integration behavior with CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics). Diagnose issues that span multiple systems (DealHub - CRM - third-party integrations), tracing root cause across API calls, data sync logic, and configuration layers. Work on a ticket system and communicate with customers via email, phone, and video calls — handling cases too complex or high-stakes for standard resolution paths. Use advanced SQL to investigate data-layer issues, validate hypotheses, and confirm fixes. Serve as the internal go-to technical reference for other Support Specialists on difficult product or integration questions. Ensure every ticket is fully solved — not just closed — with a clear understanding of why the issue occurred. Make the customer feel confident and well taken care of, even in the most technically difficult situations. Requirements Have significant, hands-on experience (several years) as a Support Specialist in B2B SaaS companies, with demonstrated depth on the hardest tier of support cases. Have advanced, proven experience with CRM integrations and implementations — able to reason about API behavior, data mapping, and sync logic, not just surface-level configuration. Have deep familiarity with business applications and CRM platforms (Salesforce / HubSpot / etc.), including their integration architecture. Have excellent communication skills and a customer-oriented approach, especially under pressure with complex or sensitive cases. Be bold, ambitious, and get things done. Think out of the box and lead a surprising, structured problem-solving approach for issues without an obvious playbook answer. Have strong, independent command of SQL queries for investigating and validating data issues. Have a bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Information Technology / Information Systems). Be a great team player, and a natural resource for others when things get technically hairy. Be fluent in English (both written and verbal). Apply to this job Back to careers page
